## b722c62a7980

**Classification: reproduced advertised-degenerate semantic defect.** No patch was made because this is an audit-only target.

Generator SHA-256 `0c033779285bea8d3ed1a6a930e1da07dabd57d2f6944c60ab69298eb754961d` advertises `all_overlap` and comments that it should make every component adjacent, producing a fully off-diagonal contact matrix. At seed `20261005`, sample index `0`, medium difficulty, override `{"texture":"all_overlap"}`, the generator places singleton colors at `(2,2)`, `(2,4)`, `(2,6)`, and `(4,2)` in a 10×13 grid. Every pair is separated by at least one background cell. The input passes `self_check`, but the canonical Racket output is the 4×4 identity matrix, not the declared matrix with 2 in every off-diagonal cell.

The supported authority command was:

```text
python3 run_with_racket.py python3 -m arcpuzzles apply b722c62a7980 \
  --input ../checks/audit/b722c62a7980/input.json \
  --out ../checks/audit/b722c62a7980/racket.json
```

It exited 0 and records executed rule hash `c9466841c78d`. Exact input, Racket output, and declared-texture output are combined in `checks/audit/b722c62a7980/finding.json`; the input is inside the documented generator domain and passes its validator. A repair should place the four components in a cardinally connected contact graph (for a complete graph, shapes larger than isolated cells are needed on a square grid) or rename/remove the degenerate claim.
